readings: Use only scanprocessing records whose zoneref matches a site in sites. Group by zoneref and that site's insurstat. For each group, show the site code, insurance status, AVG(remaingb), and AVG(proccpu - procgpu), using only records with both usage values for the latter average. Divide the group's AVG(remaingb) by the mean of all groups' nonmissing AVG(remaingb) values. Ignore missing values in every average, return no rows if that overall mean is missing, and do not round. Sort by the ratio descending with missing ratios last, and return the first 10 rows.

Use only scanprocessing records whose zoneref matches a site in sites. Group by zoneref and that site's insurstat. For each group, show the site code, insurance status, AVG(remaingb), and AVG(ABS(proccpu - procgpu)), using only records with both usage values for the latter average. Divide the group's AVG(remaingb) by the mean of all groups' nonmissing AVG(remaingb) values. Ignore missing values in every average, return no rows if that overall mean is missing, and do not round. Sort by the ratio descending with missing ratios last, and return the first 10 rows.

Use only scanprocessing records whose zoneref matches a site in sites. Group by zoneref and that site's insurstat. For each group, show the site code, insurance status, AVG(remaingb), and AVG(proccpu) - AVG(procgpu), calculating the CPU and GPU averages independently from their nonmissing values. Divide the group's AVG(remaingb) by the mean of all groups' nonmissing AVG(remaingb) values. Ignore missing values in every average, return no rows if that overall mean is missing, and do not round. Sort by the ratio descending with missing ratios last, and return the first 10 rows.
queries:
WITH site_averages AS (
    SELECT
        sp.zoneref,
        s.insurstat,
        AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL
            THEN sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu
        END) AS avg_usage_difference
    FROM scanprocessing AS sp
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
    GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_group_remaingb
    FROM site_averages
)
SELECT
    sa.zoneref,
    sa.insurstat,
    sa.avg_remaingb,
    sa.avg_usage_difference,
    sa.avg_remaingb / o.mean_group_remaingb AS ratio
FROM site_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_group_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT
        sp.zoneref,
        s.insurstat,
        AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL
            THEN ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)
        END) AS avg_usage_difference
    FROM scanprocessing AS sp
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
    GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_group_remaingb
    FROM grouped
)
SELECT
    g.zoneref,
    g.insurstat,
    g.avg_remaingb,
    g.avg_usage_difference,
    g.avg_remaingb / o.mean_group_remaingb AS ratio
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_group_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH site_groups AS (
    SELECT
        sp.zoneref,
        s.insurstat,
        AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb,
        AVG(sp.proccpu) - AVG(sp.procgpu) AS cpu_gpu_difference
    FROM scanprocessing AS sp
    JOIN sites AS s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_group_remaingb
    FROM site_groups
)
SELECT
    g.zoneref,
    g.insurstat,
    g.avg_remaingb / o.mean_group_remaingb AS remaining_storage_ratio,
    g.cpu_gpu_difference
FROM site_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_group_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY remaining_storage_ratio IS NULL, remaining_storage_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
